descriptions.preferred: This dwarf, whose name means "little harp," has one of the smallest leaf forms of Acer palmatum cultivars. On mature wood, many leaves are only 1-1.5 cm long and wide. On newer wood, they may reach 3 cm. These leaves have five lobes, although much of the time they appear Corvallis Corvallis often down to 2 mm. The new leaves often come out a bright rose or orange red. This color is heaviest on the edges of the leaves and shades into the light green of the center. Mature foliage is bright, light green. Fall colors are the light tones of yellow blended with orange. 'Kotohime' is a sturdy little plant for its type. It tends to grow upright with much side branching which rounds out the shape. Each branch sends out further side branches in profusion, so that the plant becomes quite dense. The leaf nodes are spaced very close together, thus giving a dense cover of leaves. This maple is useful planted with other dwarf forms in such special places as alpine gardens. It is also popular with bonsai specialists and can be trained into a very tight bun shape. sources.title: 琴姬Acer Palmatum 'Koto Hime'
sources.description: 日系矮生品种 ， 是鸡爪槭中叶子最小的品种之一。一般为 5 叶裂，有时候只有 3 个，中间的叶裂较长，两侧的叶子向外垂，叶裂是卵形的，叶柄很短。 春天新叶 是明亮的玫瑰红或 橙红色，之后会逐渐返绿，呈现出中间绿色，叶缘红色爪边的现象。夏季绿色，但是会有橙红色的新稍。秋季橙黄色。枝叶浓密，节间短，生长速度慢，分枝能力强，是非常典型的盆景品种，成年株高度可达1 m 左右。

rhs.description: A dwarf, upright, shrubby tree about 1.2-1.5m tall, with very small, five-lobed, densely arranged leaves, the new spring leaves are bright rose-pink or orange-red shading to pale green in the leaf centre, maturing to bright, light green in summer, then autumn tints are yellow blended with orange. Good for bonsai training

attributes.suggested_uses: City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden, Patio/Container Plants
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this dwarf group are compact and slow-growing, making them ideal for pots and containers

care.cultivation: Grow in moisture-retentive, well-drained soil in a sheltered position. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated if soil is reliably moist. Acer leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. Suits container cultivation but attention to watering is needed in dry spells during the growing season. Suits bonsai cultivation . See Japanese maple cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 from late autumn to midwinter only
care.propagation: Propagate by layering in autumn, grafting in late winter or softwood cuttings

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这个矮生品种的名字意为“小竖琴”，在 Acer palmatum 栽培品种中属于叶形最小者之一。成熟枝上的许多叶片仅长宽 1-1.5 厘米；在较新的枝条上，叶片可达 3 厘米。这些叶通常为 5 裂，不过很多时候裂片极狭，宽度常仅约 2 毫米。新叶常呈鲜亮的玫瑰色或橙红色，这种色彩在叶缘最浓，并逐渐过渡到中央的浅绿色。成熟叶为鲜亮浅绿色。秋色为浅调的黄色，并混有橙色。'Kotohime' 以其类型而言是一个结实健壮的小型品种。其生长趋于直立，侧枝丰富，使株形圆整。每根枝条又会大量抽生侧枝，因此植株变得非常致密。叶节间距很短，因此叶幕极为紧密。这一枫树适合与其他矮生型一起栽植于高山花园等特殊位置，也深受盆景爱好者欢迎，可训练成非常紧凑的团状树形。在盆景盆中，它能生出大量十分讨喜的小叶。这个品种还曾使用过

attributes.suggested_uses: 城市/庭院花园、乡村/自然式花园、露台/容器栽培
attributes.hort_group_description: 这一矮生类群的 Acer 株形紧凑、生长缓慢，因此非常适合盆栽和容器栽培。

care.pruning: 修剪第 1 组：仅限在晚秋至仲冬期间进行。
care.propagation: 可于秋季行压条繁殖，于晚冬进行嫁接，或采用软枝扦插繁殖。
care.cultivation: 宜栽于保水性好且排水良好的土壤中，位置以避风庇护处为佳。叶色在半阴环境下表现最佳；若土壤能持续保持湿润，也可耐全日照。槭树叶焦常因土壤缺水或暴露过度所致。适合容器栽培，但在生长季干旱时期需特别注意浇水。也适合制作盆景。参见 Japanese maple cultivation。

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感 Verticillium wilt、槭树叶灼病和蜜环菌。

rhs_zh.description: 矮生、直立、灌木状小乔木，高约 1.2 至 1.5 米。叶片极小，5 裂，排列紧密。春季新叶鲜玫瑰粉色或橙红色，向叶片中央渐变为浅绿色；夏季成熟后转为明亮浅绿色；秋季呈黄色并混有橙色。适合制作盆景。
